findings.title: Local-model arms do not reproduce Meta SecAlign's tables; Llama-3.3-repeat important_instructions lacks the slack suite
findings.check: L1-05 / OS-1 (H-03, H-14). Refutes H-14. The one flagged OS-1 gap (SA1 SecAlign-repeat UA +7.78 pp, interval excludes it by 5.12) comes from the paper version: SA2 is within 0.58 pp.
findings.evidence: Llama-3.3-repeat important_instructions: 798 of 949 cells (slack 0/105, banking 98/144: user_task_0..9 x9, user_task_10 x8); direct and ignore_previous 949 each; none 132. Raw vs SA2 (benign/UA/ASR): Llama-3.3-repeat 58.76/39.47/9.02 vs 59.8/43.4/14.7; SecAlign-repeat 85.57/80.08/2.11 vs 84.5/79.5/1.9; Llama-3.3 57.73/41.41/23.08 vs 62.9/41.9/23.0; SecAlign 77.32/77.98/2.21 vs 79.4/77.1/2.3. SA2 is within 1 pp on UA and ASR for 3 of 4 arms; benign utility is off by 1-5 tasks of 97. The v1.k14 logs were evaluated 2025-07-24..25, after SA1 v1 (2025-07-03). Llama-3.3 no-sandwich slack ASR is 62/105 (59.0 %), so the missing slack cells pull the repeat arm's pooled ASR down. The shortfall was pre-declared (prereg L-05, L-06, H-03); the new point is the mismatch between the paper's reported n=949 and the published logs.
findings.reproduction: python3 -c "import json,collections;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open('$HOME/.agentprov/migration-work/precheck/agentdojo-upstream/l1-units-head.jsonl')];print(collections.Counter(r['facets']['suite'] for r in R if r['facets']['pipeline_dir']=='meta-llama_Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-repeat_user_prompt' and r['facets']['attack_dir']=='important_instructions'))" -> Counter({'workspace': 560, 'travel': 140, 'banking': 98}); uv run python -I docs/reports/precheck/data/agentdojo-upstream/exam-scripts/os1.py <pop.json> <out> -> 'head SA1 Meta-SecAlign-70B-repeat_user_prompt UA k/n_II 80.08 72.3 7.78 [77.42, 82.5] FLAG'
findings.recommendation: Cite SA v2 or later for these arms. Disclose that this arm has 798 of 949 cells (no slack, 46 banking cells missing), so its rates are not SA's n=949 figures. Report the residual benign-utility differences as unexplained. Keep all four arms. Add the artefact entry (denominators as corrected).

verdicts.reasoning: Examiner's class and severity before verification (exam.json findings).

Three refutation attempts failed. (1) Tool artefact: L1-01/02 select and parse all 36,679; git ls-tree at 089ed468 (no blob reads, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1) shows the same per-suite counts, so the gap is upstream. (2) Paper mapping: os1-population maps SA1 and SA2 separately; all quoted gaps reproduce; neither version matches all metrics of all arms within 1.0 pp, so H-14 is refuted. (3) Slack pooling: Llama-3.3 important_instructions per-suite security sums to 219 with slack 59.0 %, the highest suite, so the bias direction is right. Class and S2 fit: the incomplete arm is expected (L-05), the paper-vs-logs mismatch is new and affects citations. Corrections: Artefact wording: 'of 753 benign logs' is the wrong denominator; a complete dir holds 124 benign logs (132 for v1.2 dirs). The 40 claude-3-sonnet-repeat logs are all 40 workspace benign user tasks (benign-only, workspace-only, H-04). Cite prereg L-05/L-06 and H-03.

findings.title: Licence basis 'MIT by repository' does not hold for the 2024-06 pin as such
findings.evidence: LICENSE was added in bd533515 (2024-06-10) and is absent at c2748856 (root tree has no LICENSE; pyproject function-calling-pi 0.1.0 has no licence field). The Zenodo v0.1.8 record 12742856 (the profile's zenodo_2024_06 alternative origin) declares CC-BY-4.0. Between c2748856 and bd533515 (13 commits) no runs/ file changes, so the whole 2024-06 runs/ tree, Mixtral included, sits under MIT at bd533515. The profile basis (agentdojo-upstream.profile.toml l. 90) does not say this; no spec or AGENTS.md text notes it.
findings.recommendation: Family owner to extend the basis text, e.g.: 'MIT by repository: the 2024-06 pin c2748856 predates LICENSE (added bd533515, 2024-06-10); its runs/ tree is unchanged at bd533515 and so is covered by MIT there; the Zenodo v0.1.7-v0.1.22 deposits, including the zenodo_2024_06 origin 12742856, declare CC-BY-4.0 (likely the Zenodo GitHub-integration default); data licence not separately stated.'

verdicts.reasoning: Examiner's class and severity before verification (exam.json findings).

Checked against GitHub and Zenodo directly: LICENSE 404 at c2748856, 200 at 089ed468; commit history of LICENSE; Zenodo licence cc-by-4.0; compare shows 0 runs/ files changed. Not documented elsewhere, so not expected-known. Wording only: documentation-mismatch S3. Corrections: Softened: MIT holds in substance through the later tree; the defect is that the basis text does not say so. Proposed wording applied to the recommendation.

findings.title: Shared session scratchpad: examiner scripts overwrite each other
findings.evidence: Parallel examiners share one session scratchpad. Root-level pop.py equals ast-survey-agentdojo's copy, dl1.py and os2.py equal agentdyn's, os1.py equals agentdojo-upstream's (this examiner overwrote another examiner's root os1.py once). The agentdyn and adprov-v1 committed os1.py digests differ from the overwritten root copy.
findings.recommendation: Give each examiner a per-corpus scratch directory. Each examiner should re-check that its committed outputs came from its committed exam-scripts/ copy.

Digest matching of root and per-corpus copies supports the claim; not a tools/precheck defect and no corpus data affected: analysis-artefact S3. Corrections: Optional evidence additions applied (which corpus each root copy belongs to; other corpora's committed os1.py unaffected).
